events.text:
T-140 is still blocked. The two blog screenshots are finished, but the three Tantra screenshots need a browser signed in to Tantra, and this run has no way to open one.

- **s1-blog #2 and #6:** done. Both guide entries point at real images, and the commit that added them (f1db2ea) is already on origin/main, so I didn't push main. I also didn't publish a demo post to the mirror, because #6 already shows a real post on the funnel's own /blog page at phone width (390 px).
- **s3-tantra-pro-flow #5, #13, #14:** blocked. This run has no Claude in Chrome tools, and Brave doesn't expose a debug port that I could connect to. The note saying T-115 was unblocked is wrong: T-115 is still blocked. So I added these three screenshots to T-115's existing sign-in request instead of making a new one. That means the two "Adi test" contacts and the test campaign haven't been created yet.
- **check-guides capture-needed down by 5:** 2 of 5 so far. It passes at 57 now and will drop by the other 3 once the Tantra screenshots land.
- **What's needed:** Adi opens one Claude Code desktop session with Claude in Chrome connected to the Brave profile signed in to usetantra.com as [email], then types "Act on T-115, T-339 and T-140". Claude then creates the test contacts, takes the three screenshots, deletes what it created and logs that in the revert ledger.

I acked both notes (F-7ac92182 and R-3fd1f10e). No files changed this run, so there's nothing to commit.
